description: Capability for both app windows. Note: the app's own #[tauri::command] handlers (list_devices, start_capture, etc. in commands.rs) aren't gated by this file at all - Tauri's capability/ACL system only governs plugin commands and certain core APIs invoked directly from the frontend, not custom commands registered via invoke_handler. This still needs to list both window labels (not the default scaffold's "main", which neither of our windows is labeled) for the plugin permissions below to apply to them.
